items.title: Ransomware Attacks on Manufacturers Surge as Supply Chain Risk Grows
items.summary: Research shows attacks on manufacturers rose 40% in early 2026, as ransomware groups increasingly exploit the supply-chain disruption caused by operational shutdowns. The post Ransomware Attacks on Manufacturers Surge as Supply Chain Risk Grows appeared first on SecurityWeek .
items.title_zh: 供應鏈風險增加，製造商遭受勒索軟體攻擊大幅激增
items.summary_zh: 研究顯示，2026 年初對製造商的攻擊上升了 40%，勒索軟體集團日益利用營運中斷所造成的供應鏈混亂。該文章《Ransomware Attacks on Manufacturers Surge as Supply Chain Risk Grows》首次發表於 SecurityWeek。

items.title: Active Exploitation Triggers Emergency Patch for Cisco ISE Zero-Day
items.summary: Remote, unauthenticated attackers can exploit the vulnerability to bypass authentication via crafted requests. The post Active Exploitation Triggers Emergency Patch for Cisco ISE Zero-Day appeared first on SecurityWeek .
items.title_zh: 積極利用觸發 Cisco ISE 零日漏洞的緊急修補程式
items.summary_zh: 遠端未經身分驗證的攻擊者可透過精心設計的請求利用該漏洞繞過身分驗證。該文章《Active Exploitation Triggers Emergency Patch for Cisco ISE Zero-Day》首次發表於 SecurityWeek。

items.title: The true cost of a ransomware attack, with and without BCDR
items.summary: The ransom itself can be only a fraction of the total cost of a ransomware attack, with downtime, recovery, remediation, and legal obligations adding millions to the bill. Datto explains how a mature BCDR strategy can reduce downtime and provide a faster, more predictable path to recovery. [...]
items.title_zh: 有無 BCDR 情況下勒索軟體攻擊的真正代價
items.summary_zh: 贖金本身可能僅佔勒索軟體攻擊總成本的一小部分，停機時間、復原、修復和法律義務會使帳單增加數百萬美元。Datto 解釋了成熟的 BCDR 策略如何減少停機時間，並提供更快速且更可預測的復原途徑。[...]
